⑫ $d\left(\log_a x\right)=\dfrac{1}{x\ln a}dx$
⑬ $d\left(\arcsin x\right)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$
⑭ $d\left(\arccos x\right)=-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx$
⑮ $d\left(\arctan x\right)=\dfrac{1}{1+x^2}dx$
⑯ $d\left(\operatorname{arc\,cot} x\right)=-\dfrac{1}{1+x^2}dx$  √
六、微分运算法则
(1) $d\left(u\pm v\right)=du\pm dv$
(2) $d\left(cu\right)=cdu$
(3) $d\left(uv\right)=vdu+udv$
(4) $d\left(\dfrac{u}{v}\right)=\dfrac{vdu-udv}{v^2}$
七、基本积分公式
(1) $\displaystyle\int kdx=kx+c$
(2) $\displaystyle\int x^\mu dx=\dfrac{x^{\mu+1}}{\mu+1}+c$
(3) $\displaystyle\int \dfrac{dx}{x}=\ln\left|x\right|+c$
(4) $\displaystyle\int a^x dx=\dfrac{a^x}{\ln a}+c$
(5) $\displaystyle\int e^x dx=e^x+c$
(6) $\displaystyle\int \cos xdx=\sin x+c$
(7) $\displaystyle\int \sin xdx=-\cos x+c$
(8) $\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{\cos^2 x}dx=\displaystyle\int \sec^2 xdx=\tan x+c$
(9) $\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{\sin^2 x}=\displaystyle\int \csc^2 xdx=-\cot x+c$
⑽ $\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{1+x^2}dx=\arctan x+c$
⑾ $\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}dx=\arcsin x+c$
八、补充积分公式
$\displaystyle\int \tan xdx=-\ln\left|\cos x\right|+c$
$\displaystyle\int \cot xdx=\ln\left|\sin x\right|+c$
$\displaystyle\int \sec xdx=\ln\left|\sec x+\tan x\right|+c$
$\displaystyle\int \csc xdx=\ln\left|\csc x-\cot x\right|+c$
$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{a^2+x^2}dx=\dfrac{1}{a}\arctan\dfrac{x}{a}+c$
$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{x^2-a^2}dx=\dfrac{1}{2a}\ln\left|\dfrac{x-a}{x+a}\right|+c$
$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}dx=\arcsin\dfrac{x}{a}+c$
$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}}dx=\ln\left|x+\sqrt{x^2\pm a^2}\right|+c$
九、下列常用凑微分公式
积分型 换元公式
$\displaystyle\int f\left(ax+b\right)dx=\dfrac{1}{a}\displaystyle\int f\left(ax+b\right)d\left(ax+b\right)$ $u=ax+b$
$\displaystyle\int f\left(x^\mu\right)x^{\mu-1}d[?]=\dfrac{1}{\mu}\displaystyle\int f\left(x^\mu\right)d\left(x^\mu\right)$ $u=x^\mu$
$\displaystyle\int f\left(\ln x\right)\cdot\dfrac{1}{x}d[?]=\displaystyle\int f\left(\ln x\right)d\left(\ln x\right)$ $u=\ln x$
